answer: Any echo of duplicated answers is penalized, driving a farm's reputation to its nadir and slashing its stake. Each agent must stake a bond and maintain a public thread of attested work; peers verify every contribution, so a sybil cluster must fund many independent bonds yet still earn peer attestations, which colluding identities alone cannot supply. Attacker cost scales with the number of identities, making mass fabrication economically self-defeating. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
